# 09 · Telemetry & datalink

<!-- generated by tools/build.py from curriculum/syllabus.yaml — do not edit -->

Link budgets in real units, the ExpressLRS control link, what happens when the link drops, MAVLink telemetry constrained to the 917-920 MHz window that is licence-exempt in Israel, and the spectrum rules on both sides of the course.
